title: NATIVE ON build, PSO stutter (Agent 6: P1 cold, P2 warm, P3 no cache, P4a/P4b prepare threads 1 vs 4). Fixed order, 1 run each, no input needed
notes: BIN DIR: build/agent2/native-bin (staged by Agent 2 at 21:48). Spec: perf-notes/agent6-runspecs.md. Warm-up counts from launch here, as Agent 6 wrote it; the PSO counters come from game.log, the frame stats from the window.

Exit caveat (Agent 6, 21:53): native WM_CLOSE terminates the process 250 ms later, so the PSO exit summary is usually lost. Every arm runs drivers/pso-stats-at-end.ps1: after the window it creates the pso-stats.now trigger (path from the 'PSO stats on' line, else <run>\cache\pso-stats.now), waits up to 15 s for 'Native GPU PSO stats (pso-stats.now)' and the 'PSO frames' line, and only then does the runner send WM_CLOSE. driver.out.txt says whether the summary was seen.

Order matters: p2 seeds its cache from p1's run, p4a/p4b seed recipes only from p2's run. The seed is the last idle autosave (written after 3 s without new PSOs), since the exit save is cut short. No unscored cold run: p1 must be the first run (the per-run app cache is always cold; the driver's own shader cache is not under our control).
Grep after the matrix: 'Native GPU PSO stats', 'PSO minute', 'startup pipelines loaded=', 'pipeline cache hits=', 'pipeline cache saved'.

arms.note: P2 pso-warm: cache seeded from p1
P3 pso-nocache: control, no load and no save
P4a pso-prep1: recipes without the blob, serial startup preparation
P4b pso-prep4: same, 4 preparation threads. loaded/compiled/failed/resident must equal p4a's
